title: Gandhi Ji In South Africa 1894 1914
definition: A formative two-decade period (1894-1914) where M.K. Gandhi evolved his political philosophy of Satyagraha, organizational skills, and mass mobilization techniques against racial discrimination in South Africa.
importanceInUpsc: This period serves as the 'laboratory' for Gandhi's later Indian nationalist movements; UPSC frequently tests the evolution of his methods, specific institutions founded, and the transition from moderate petitioning to militant non-violent resistance.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Gandhi Ji In South Africa 1894 1914.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Indian National Movement
Understanding of Colonialism and Racial Segregation
